# GdayMeetings 0.3.6

Fixes missing collection cards on the CMS dashboard and the `PayloadComponent not found in importMap` warning affecting earlier releases, including 0.3.5.

The Payload component map is now generated before every production build. CI checks that the committed map is current, and both native container tests verify the authenticated dashboard renders all five collection cards before checking file uploads, downloads and deletion.

No database changes. Container: ghcr.io/rankun203/gday-meetings:0.3.6. The release updates latest after AMD64 and ARM64 checks pass; no unknown-platform manifests are included.
